# Controlled ADR context

Architecture-shaped work must consult `docs/adrs/README.md` and the current
records it indexes. The index and each record's in-file `Status` are the
authoritative status signals. If they disagree, stop and ask a human to resolve
the ambiguity. Filenames are navigation aids, not status authority.

Humans own ADR proposal, consultation, acceptance, rejection, supersession, and
exceptions. Agents may cite decisions, stop on conflicts, and make mechanical
record updates only after explicit human direction. Explicit exceptions are
recorded in the repository's change log. Planning does not override Accepted
ADRs.
